summary: All three round-1 minor findings are correctly resolved in fe86f5b. (1) EVENT_TELEGRAM_SEND_FAILED audit: four sendPhoto terminal-failure unit tests (403, 400/chat-not-found, 400/other, 5xx-exhausted) each received `verify(eventService).logEvent(eq(OWNER_ID), eq(TelegramSender.EVENT_TELEGRAM_SEND_FAILED), isNull(), isNull(), any())` — identical signature to the sendText pattern at line 447 and line 884/904/925/941. (2) 429-retry path assertion: `sendPhoto_rateLimited_retriesThenSucceeds` now calls `mockServer.takeRequest` twice and asserts both `RecordedRequest.getPath()` equal `/bot<TOKEN>/sendPhoto`, matching the guard that was already present in the sendText retry tests. (3) IT times(1) guard: `sendPhoto_chatNotFound_marksDeletedByChat` in TelegramSenderSubscriberHookIT now contains `verify(subscriberService, times(1)).markDeletedByChatId(PROJECT_ID, TELEGRAM_BOT_ID, CHAT_ID)`, symmetric with the existing `times(1)` guard for `markBlockedByChatId` in the 403 test at line 221. No new issues found.
